in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is endowed with knowledge and action

in_marathi.name: Nishika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nishika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nishika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nisha' which means 'night'. The suffix 'ka' is added to form a feminine name. In Hindu mythology, the night sky is adorned with stars which twinkle and light up the darkness. Nishika symbolizes the radiant beauty of the night sky and the wisdom that comes with it.
